mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, auth_version, role_ids::text AS role_ids_json, permission_codes::text AS permission_codes_json, menu_codes::text AS menu_codes_json, column_settings::text AS column_settings_json, snapshot_hash, expires_at, built_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM iam_authorization_snapshot WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_authorization_snapshot ( tenant_id, user_id, auth_version, role_ids, permission_codes, menu_codes, column_settings, snapshot_hash, expires_at, built_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{authVersion}, CAST(#{roleIdsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{permissionCodesJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{menuCodesJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{columnSettingsJson} AS jsonb), #{snapshotHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{builtAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_authorization_snapshot SET auth_version = #{authVersion}, role_ids = CAST(#{roleIdsJson} AS jsonb), permission_codes = CAST(#{permissionCodesJson} AS jsonb), menu_codes = CAST(#{menuCodesJson} AS jsonb), column_settings = CAST(#{columnSettingsJson} AS jsonb), snapshot_hash = #{snapshotHash}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, built_at = #{builtAt}, created_by = #{createdBy}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
